purpose: Negative control for treating functional matching as evidence of target-specific deobfuscation
budget: one execution, existing 531 messages, no new benchmark generation
attacker_knowledge: Public standard SHA-256 function and message bytes; no target binary, target trace, source mapping, or expected digest passed to attack function
attack: Return node:crypto SHA-256 of message without reading the protected program
verifier: Compare returned digest against saved expected digest; verify input bundle hash first
expected_implication: If all match, functional agreement alone does not distinguish this target-ignoring control from target-specific recovery
limits: Not a Wasm ABI replacement or internal-location recovery; no attack-time, resistance, or novelty claim
